name: Black Leg
description: Kicks only, from the kitchen masters of the seas: later heated kicks, then burning ones.

stages.name: Kick drills
stages.description: Legs only: hands are for cooking.
stages.text: You fought with your legs alone and kept your hands clean.

stages.name: Heated kicks
stages.description: Kicks so fast they burn from the friction.
stages.text: Your leg glowed red with the heat of your kicks.

stages.name: Burning kicks with haki
stages.text: Your kicks burned and hardened at once.

stages.name: Master of the Black Leg
stages.description: A cook's style, and a fighter's.
stages.text: No cook on the seas kicked like you.

teachers.name: the head chef of the Baratie
